title: Mixed Event — The Moon Rabbit & Us

meta.Outline: With MORE MORE JUMP!'s next stream approaching, Shizuku starts thinking of autumn-themed ideas, triggering childhood memories of when she went moon viewing with Shiho. She invites her sister to go together once again...

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Member A
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Another exhausting practice...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone.
We got quite a lot done today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
Your technique is so beautiful, Asahina. I learned so much just by watching you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you, I'm glad you thought so.

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Member B
rows.Line:
She's so right!
But you did really well too, Hinomori. You don't look tired at all.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, Hinomori, you emptied quite a few quivers. Are you sure you're not tired?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm fine.
I am a little tired, but I feel like I can keep going as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Being an idol and all, I'm not always able to be here, so I also need to work harder than most to make up for that lost time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. That's very commendable.

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Member A
rows.Line: Yeah, even though you're busy as an idol, you still find the time to put in the work here. If I don't do the same, you'll end up leaving me behind!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. I'll try my best to do the same.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But for now, let's all go home and get some rest. We can continue next time we meet.

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Member A
rows.Line:
Okay!
Bye, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Member B
rows.Line: See you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It was so nice to be able to focus on this for once.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Let's see... Next, I have to start thinking of ideas for our stream.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What would be good for our next segment...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Everyone else always comes up with such wonderful ideas, so I'm hoping to be able to contribute this time!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But still...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Oh, I know...!
We could have a squeaky-clean cleaning contest or a blindfolded udon tasting challenge!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Doing a cleaning contest would also be a nice way to straighten out our rooms as well...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (The udon challenge would even mean that we'd get to try different kinds of noodles too...! That sounds wonderfully delicious...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I feel like I can still do better...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is everything okay, Hinomori? Is something bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Asahina...
It's nothing, but I appreciate your concern.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh? If you say so...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But if there is something on your mind, don't hesitate to ask me for help.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Asahina...
Thank you, I think I'll take you up on that offer.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm trying to come up with some ideas regarding what my idol group should do next.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Your idol group...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Asahina...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
I've never been asked about anything like this before, so I was caught a little off guard.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Um... I don't know much about idols, so I'm not sure how much I'll be able to help... But I'd like to hear what's on your mind if that's okay with you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Just talking may even help.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
Alright, we can try that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see...
So you need ideas for your stream.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. The other girls in my group are always coming up with such great ideas, so I was hoping that maybe I could this time...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. That's so thoughtful of you, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'd like to help somehow...
Hmm... Ideas for your stream...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, what if you did something with some seasonal flair to it?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Seasonal flair?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. Fall is just about upon us, so it might be nice to introduce some seasonal desserts or even just books that you might recommend...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, moon viewing as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Moon viewing...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Shii and I used to do those all the time when we were little. We haven't done one in quite a while since we've grown older...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Hehe.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I think this is the best I can do for now. I wish I could've done better.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, you were enormously helpful.
I do think something seasonal is the way to go!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Videos involving food also rarely ever disappoint and we'd get to introduce the things we like, so it sounds like a wonderful plan.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But moon viewing...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (If possible, I'd really like to do that with Shii...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You've given me some great ideas, Asahina. Thank you so much.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Don't mention it.
I'm just glad that I was able to help.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, it's getting pretty late...
I need to head to cram school soon.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to your stream.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, again, thank you!
Please be safe.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'm so glad I asked her about this. She gave me so many good ideas...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Once I get home, I should put pen to paper and sort them all out.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But before I do that...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Maybe I can spend some time looking for that photo.
Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hmm... Maybe that moon viewing photo is in this album...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh no, it's Shii's baby pictures.
She's so cute...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And this must be from the Doll Festival. We used to not eat the rice puffs and use them as decorations because of their adorable designs.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, this was when we still wore matching clothes... Hairstyles too...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. The way Shii used to say she wanted to be just like me was almost too much at times...

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Voice
rows.Line: Shizuku, dinner's almost ready.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Shii!
You came to get me?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Because you weren't answering at all.
Hey, what are you looking at...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. They're pictures of when we were little.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I asked Asahina for some advice today after we finished up with practice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Asahina...?
Oh, the really popular girl from the archery club?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, she's a really incredible person.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Anyway, I asked her for some advice, and what she said reminded me of when we used to do moon viewings, Shii.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Moon viewings...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I was looking for a photo of us from back then and I found all these other adorable pictures of you...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, I get it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I should ask just in case...
You don't plan on showing anyone those, do you?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, I hadn't thought about that but...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know! I could show them to Asahina as a way to thank her and get her to learn a little more about you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Not happening.
Besides, she'd probably be really confused if you tried anything like that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You think so?
But you're absolutely adorable in these photos... You even have some sauce stuck to your cheek in this one...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you show that to anyone, I'm not talking to you anymore.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What?! No...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Still, I remember how we used to play together all the time...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We did...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, for example...
That time we waited at the park with grandma while our mother came to pick us up...
A few years ago

rows.Speaker: Grandmother
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho, what are you making there?

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: A sandy mountain...

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line:
It's so big.
You're amazing, Shii♪

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, can you put your hand through there for me?

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: Like this?

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Then, I'll move some sand away like this and...

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: There...!

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, look at that!
I can see you through the mountain, Shii.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: I can see you too, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. This is wonderful.
I guess we can name it Mt. Shii after you.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: No way...

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: But it's such a lovely name...

rows.Speaker: Grandmother
rows.Line: Hehe. Are you a little embarrassed about that, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Let's name it after you instead, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line:
Me?!
Hehe. Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: You're so incredible, Shii. You know so many ways of having fun that I'd never be able to imagine.

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: Would you mind showing me more while we wait for mommy to come pick us up?

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: Next, I'll take some sand and curl them up to make...

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: Here, lots and lots of dango.

rows.Speaker: Grandmother
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. These look so good, Shiho. I might just mistake them for the real thing.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: I really doubt that...

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, Shii, what do you want to play next?

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: Hmm... How about...?
Shiho, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Sorry for being so late.
This koto lesson ended up going overtime...

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho & Shizuku
rows.Line: Mommy...!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Were you two okay? I hope you weren't lonely.

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: We weren't lonely at all. Shiho, grandma and I played lots together.

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: Right, Shii?

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. You two are so close.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: And thank you for looking after them like this.

rows.Speaker: Grandmother
rows.Line: Oh, it was my pleasure. I even ended up playing with them♪

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, mommy.
The dango grandma made for us was really good.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: Yours too, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thanks♪
But yours were even better than that, Shii.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. In that case, would you two like to help out with dinner tonight?

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Then we'll need to head right home.
Tonight, we're having Salisbury steaks.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: Salisbury steak...!

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's make some really good ones, Shii.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: After that, we made some together and put so much love into them. It even seemed like they tasted much better than normal too...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That really happened...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it did. The way you treated me as your big sister was so cute too...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, here it is! The moon viewing photo I was looking for. This is fantastic. It's from your first moon viewing after you started kindergarten...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay, okay.
You never get tired of this, do you...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course not. That's because you were cute back then and even now, Shii!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That's not what I was asking.
Anyways, we should probably...

rows.Speaker: Mother's Voice
rows.Line: Shiho, Shizuku, dinner.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
There's mom, right on cue...
I'm heading back down.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: W-Wait, Shii!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What now? I think you've reminisced over photos enough...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was wondering if you'd like to do a moon viewing together since it's been so long...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We did them as a family when we were little, but we haven't done one in quite some time, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which is why I was hoping to do one with you like old times... What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry, I'm too busy with practice and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're about to do our first show as Leo/need too. We all decided to try and go pro together, so I need to give this everything I have right now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, sorry...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, I understand.
It's your big dream, so I suppose there's no choice.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Please, Shii, do your best.
I'll be cheering you on.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She's been working so hard every single day...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It seemed like she had a lot on her mind until recently, but now she looks like she's having so much fun chasing after her dream like this...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'm sure she'll face some tough challenges moving forward, but I know she won't back down from them...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. That means I need to do my best too...
The next day
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hi, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hello, Minori!
Oh, all of you are here♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, we'd like to talk to you about what we'll be doing for our next stream. Would any of you be available for a quick discussion?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Of course♪
I can't wait to hear what you'll be doing!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks!
And thanks for always helping us out like this.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then why don't we get right down to it♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, about our next segment...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh... I actually have some ideas that I'd like to discuss with you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You do? That's great, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, lay it on us!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you!
If you'll allow me to explain...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. A fall-based segment...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. We'd be able to introduce books, sports and even foods that we like or recommend. Wouldn't that be wonderful?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! That sounds great!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I agree. That sounds really amazing!
Fall's the season for roasted sweet potatoes, Mont Blanc cakes and pumpkin pie...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're just saying that because you want to eat them, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Whether they're being eaten or you yourselves are eating them, delicious foods do seem like a good choice!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
We won't be able to have too much...
But it could be interesting if each of us recommended something and did a little taste test.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, you'd even learn a little about what someone's like based on what they choose♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That would be interesting. It may also be fun to make some yourself♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Is it time for Minori's salt-instead-of-sugar flan or Shizuku's flan that's really some other kind of egg dish to finally make an appearance?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're so mean, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: There's no way I'd do that!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haha. Relax, I'm kidding!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'm so jealous!
I wanna do that with you guys too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too♪ Although, just talking about it is already pretty exciting.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I agree♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Dessert making sounds lovely and it may be fun to see all of you breaking a sweat while playing some sports too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Breaking a sweat...? Oh!
Like a squeaky-clean cleaning contest!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We can compete to see who can get their room to be the cleanest! We'd be breaking a sweat, but it's also an opportunity to really clean our rooms♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
It's not a bad idea...
But I feel like that might get old fast.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi may be right. However, it may be something to consider after we eat a little too much.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What if you made it a sort of time trial? Wouldn't that make it more interesting?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, yes it would♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You'll have to get through me to win!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. This is turning into quite the segment.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, but...
I'd sort of prefer it if we did something more directly related to fall.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: More directly related...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, they're all individually great ideas, but not really all that fall-related or different from what we usually do, you know?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I still think they'd be really fun...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: At the same time, I see Airi's point.

rows.Speaker: Everybody
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me!
Since it's fall, why not do a moon viewing♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You could even invite your fans to join you on the night of the 15th, no?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A moon viewing...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I never would've thought of that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I like it since it fits right in with our seasonal theme!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (A moon viewing...)

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: Um, how did you make that rabbit?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree...
I especially like the part about our fans being able to join in on the festivities.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Together with your fans...
That means you'll all be looking up towards the same moon.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That sounds so romantic!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But what do we do during that time?
We can't just all blankly stare at the moon while we're live.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, for instance...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We could make, put some dango on display and eat the rest, or make some rabbit masks and pretend to be rabbits while we stream.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, rabbit masks!
I wanna try making some too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've never made dango before, so I'd really like to give that a try! I bet it'll be really fun!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure it will be. I also believe that it'll be a wonderful way for us to express ourselves as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Not only that, it'll feel like a special occasion. I say why not?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, I'm up for it too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: However, we'll need to work out what exactly we'll be doing, such as what activities we'll be doing and what we'll need to prepare in advance.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh...!
In that case, would you mind if I handled all of that?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Are you sure, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! I think I have a wonderful idea for this, so please let me do this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're that set on this, huh? We're gonna be expecting something really good.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course. You can count on me!
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Phew...
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa, how awesome were we just now?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, I thought the same thing...!
That may've been the best we've ever sounded...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I agree. That definitely was our best yet.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Some things are still bugging me a little, but we should be able to fix them before our show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Y-Yay!
Shiho praised us, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's great.
Especially considering how hard you girls have been working.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You're writing your own song too, right?
How's that been going?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: At this point, we're just hammering out the details. It'll be ready soon.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really? I can't wait to hear it♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
And Ichika's writing the lyrics, yes?
Any progress on that front?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, I'm not really happy with what I have right now, so I'm going to need a little more time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. But you don't need to feel rushed, okay? I'm sure you'll find the answer if you keep at it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, what she said!
You might get a light bulb just completely out of the blue one day. You just really never know♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Can you really count on that?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Thanks, Miku, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Practices, when we're all together like this, is going well, and our original song's coming along nicely.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We're really gonna get to do a show as a band...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, once more from the top. We need to make what we just did second nature.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Right. I'll count us in.
One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Phew! Great work today, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, that went so well.
Especially our last one.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, it felt so solid.
It's hard for me to put it into words, but it's like we're becoming one with the music...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
We've really come a long way.
However, some parts still need work.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So let's keep this up and make our show a good one.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But make sure not to push yourselves too hard.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, that's true too.
It's important to take breaks from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Taking breaks, huh...?

That'd be great!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I agree...
Anyway, Shizuku, mind getting back in the driver's seat?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course. Let's start by mixing some flour with water...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then we just rinse them off with cold water and let them breathe a little. For now, that'll be it for our dango-making segment.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: While we wait, why don't we move on to our next segment?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Ready, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! One, two...!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: It's Happy Bunny Rabbit Time!

rows.Speaker: Everybody
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A moon viewing isn't a moon viewing without rabbits! In this segment, we'll be making rabbit masks and pretending to be cute little bunnies!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We'd like it if you the viewers also joined us as we make our masks.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And while we make them, make sure to post some comments and suggestions for us. It'd also be great to hear about some of your own moon viewing stories.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Now, shall we get started?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I can't wait to see what they make.>
<I'm gonna make one too!>
<Moon viewings, huh? Haven't done one for a while...>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Cherry blossoms are one thing, but moon viewings?>
<Their dango looked good enough to sell at a store.>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <I wanna hear about some MMJ moon viewing stories.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our stories...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Any thoughts?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well, I...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Care to share something with us, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Me? Um, well...
It's not all that interesting but...

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I wanna hear!>
<Yeah, Shizuku, give us a moon viewing story!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Everybody seems very eager to hear from you, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh wow...
In that case, if you'll allow...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I have a sister who's one year younger than me and we used to do moon viewings every year when we were little.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: When we were in kindergarten, we even had a chance to make some rabbit-shaped dango together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Even after we moved up to elementary school, we made sure to keep doing moon viewings on the night of the 15th. Hehe. It became a sort of family tradition for us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You two must be so close.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku loves her little sister very much!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. I do.
Her name's Shii, and she's so cute and hard-working and... I don't know what I'd do without her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Unfortunately, our parents both work so it's difficult to plan family gatherings, but I never feel lonely as long as I have Shii there with me.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<They're BFFs.>
<I have a feeling that Shizuku's little sister is just like her.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I wish you could meet her and see just how cute she is. Not just that, she's a very strong girl too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She's in a band with her friends and they just recently decided to start working towards becoming professionals.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure they'll face their share of challenges, but I'm certain that they won't have any trouble overcoming them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds like she has a really good work ethic.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, she really does!
Seeing her doing what she can to make her dreams come true has saved me in the past...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But at the same time, even if it's just occasionally, I wish she'd confide in me a little more...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Confide in you...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, she's the type of person who helps others before helping herself.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I'd really like it if she saw me more as a source of comfort.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<She's such a good big sister.>
<Comfort us too, Shizuku...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A long time ago, when I was going through a bit of a tough time, Shii encouraged me by just being the hard-working girl that she is.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She gave me the courage to stand back up and try again.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's why I'd like it if she would tell me when something's wrong or if she needs my help.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She's given me so much already, so I want to give back to her somehow.
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Geez, she's telling everyone about what happened when we were just kids...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
She was encouraged by me?
I never knew that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I was sure that she was the one who's been keeping me afloat while I gave nothing back in return.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (At the same time...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You've faced your own share of hurdles as well and managed to overcome them, right, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Isn't it fair to say that your sister received some encouragement after seeing you accomplish that just as you did when you saw her working so hard?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I've helped her? I really hope that's true...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Voice
rows.Line:
<That concludes this stream...
See you next time, everyone!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, it's over...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I should probably talk to her when I get home...

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shizuku, you there? Hm? Whoa...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Shii, welcome home!
Our stream just ended and we're just about to have some dango.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
Um, Shizuku, about today...

rows.Speaker: Airi's Voice
rows.Line: Shizuku? Is someone there?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Minori, and...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry, I didn't realize you were all here...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, uh... I'll come back and ask again later, okay?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, please, stay...
We've finished our stream so...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Exactly. Would you like to have some dango with us, Shii?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, that's okay. I'll pass...
I'd feel bad since all your friends are here...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, nonsense.
Please, Shii, come join us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I mean, just look at this dango.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wait, hold on...
Is that a rabbit...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, we made them during our stream.
It's just like the ones you showed me how to make when we were little.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, I'll make an exception today...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Everyone, allow me to introduce my younger sister, Shii.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
And, Shii, this is MORE MORE JUMP!
Their names are...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Momoi, Kiritani and Minori...
Minori's in my class and I had a chance to talk to Kiritani already at the Seaside School since we were in the same group.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I'm Shiho Hinomori...
Thank you for always keeping an eye on my sister.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. It's our pleasure.
You seem so well-put-together too. Are you sure you're really the younger one here?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Isn't she such a good girl?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But you're her big sister. Shouldn't she be the one looking up to you...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. It's nice to see you again.
I hope we can keep getting to know each other more.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, me too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And don't hesitate to ask me about Haruka if you have any questions, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That goes for you too, Haruka!
I'll try to answer any questions you have about Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Try? So I guess it's not anything goes with me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-Because Shizuku probably knows so much more about you than I do...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, so feel free to ask anything you'd like about Shii!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Can't she just ask me directly?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Shii and I get to have a moon viewing party like this. I couldn't ask for more...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What's up, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I was just thinking that it's such a beautiful night for a moon viewing. I'm sure the rabbit up there is smiling back at us too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The rabbit...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, you might be right...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Um, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, Shii?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You've given me so much too, so...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you, Shii...
